## Project Tracker 1.1.6

- Removed the simulated bottom gesture indicator while preserving the bottom spacing.
- Newly added milestones are scrolled into view in the marker list, and long-pressing a marker opens Edit / Delete actions.
- New milestone percentages add to current progress as the next step, rather than being treated as the project total. The form caps additions at 100%.
- Updated the app icon to a flat fluorescent rising graph on a black background across Android and the web preview.

The release includes the transparent, independently configured project widget, local reminders, and local project storage. Project data stays on-device.

Download `Project-Tracker.apk`. It uses your private release key if GitHub Actions signing secrets are configured; otherwise it is debug-signed.
